title: Audit and potentially remove playwright.test.config.ts
body: A minimal `playwright.test.config.ts` was created during debugging to run the mobile hamburger E2E tests against the existing dev server at localhost:3000. Check if this is needed long-term or if the tests can be integrated into the existing E2E config. File: `playwright.test.config.ts`
rationale: Temporary debug config may not belong in the codebase permanently. The existing E2E test infrastructure should be used if compatible.
